Harini’s approach to problem-solving left an impression during our rollout of dynamic ad personalization. When our team faced inconsistent performance in image-based targeting, she proposed retraining the computer vision models to prioritize contextual cues in user-generated content. Her adjustments—refining feature extraction layers in PyTorch and integrating attention mechanisms—boosted click-through rates by 18% in Q3. She didn’t just execute the fix; she questioned our assumptions about data labeling and pushed for a more robust validation pipeline.  

Harini is a Staff ML Engineer at AdVeris, where she owns end-to-end workflows for recommendation systems and computer vision projects. Her work bridges complex technical challenges with business outcomes, often serving as the go-to for troubleshooting model drift in high-stakes campaigns. She balances deep technical expertise with a knack for simplifying abstract concepts for cross-functional teams.  

Beyond technical skills, Harini’s reliability and curiosity drive her impact. She’s the first to volunteer for late-night debugging sessions and the last to leave when a production issue arises. Her ability to distill vague business needs into actionable ML strategies has been critical to our adtech solutions.  

Harini’s combination of technical rigor, adaptability, and collaborative mindset makes her an asset to any team. She’s not just a contributor—she’s someone who elevates the people around her.
